# prime-tree

prime-rs: Tree component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/tree) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-tree) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/tree.md)

Tree — port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-tree`.

Hierarchical data with expansion, selection (`Single`, `Multiple`, `Checkbox`) and a filter. Nodes are `TreeNode`
with a unique `key`: expanded and selected nodes are stored as key sets in signals (`Tree` accepts external
`expanded_keys` and `selection`), the nodes themselves are immutable. Lazy loading is up to the user: in
`on_node_expand` they update the `value` signal.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_tree::{Tree, TreeNode};

let nodes = vec![TreeNode::new("0").label("Documents").expanded(true).children(vec![TreeNode::new("0-0").label("Work")])];
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <Tree value=nodes /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-tree-root-children") && html.contains("role=\"tree\"") && html.contains("Work"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-tree = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["tree"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
